上下行频率之差：VHF 通常 0.6MHz，UHF 通常 5MHz。: The difference between uplink and downlink: usually 0.6 MHz on VHF and 5 MHz on UHF.
中继台发射时会回传自身信号，用于确认是否打开中继。: The repeater retransmits your own signal, which confirms that you have opened it.
中继台用上行频率接收、下行频率发射，同时转发，扩大覆盖。: The repeater receives on the uplink and transmits on the downlink simultaneously, extending coverage.
互联网无线电连接项目，连接各地中继台，需先听再发。: An Internet radio linking project connecting repeaters worldwide — listen first, then transmit.
双时隙、色码与通话组，商业与业余广泛使用。: Two time slots, colour codes and talkgroups; widely used commercially and by amateurs.

开源 Asterisk 语音网关，支持自建节点与链路互联。: An open-source Asterisk voice gateway supporting self-hosted nodes and linked networks.
把电台经互联网互联，可用电脑/手机接入远地中继或会议。: Links radios over the Internet, so a computer or phone can join distant repeaters or conference rooms.
